'''Torwald''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Keldroth was part of the Imperial forces that established the [[Imperial Lodgement]] in the [[Minimum Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and sold goods to other Imperial forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Torwald appears as a Specialty Goods Vendor for Imperial players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
